text: Remind me to book the hull inspection at the Porto yard before the end of November.

Quick update on a few things. The Porto yard quoted 4,200 euros to fix the hull, valid until December. Moss Lantern got twelve new testers from the Reddit launch this week. And my knee physio with Tomas Brandt moved to Thursday at nine.
About the hull inspection: the Porto yard can do it on 21 November.
The Fernhill cabin listing dropped to 182,000 euros on 3 November, and the selling agent is Sten Calder.
I started cello lessons with a teacher called Marguerite Osei, every Tuesday at six.
Dentist appointment with Dr. Ilse Varga moved to 3 December at half past ten.
Car: the spare wheel needs 3.1 bar, I checked the sticker in the boot.
Idea for agent planning doctrine: every ticket gets exactly one owner and one done-means line.
The backup disk on the second VPS is at 91 percent, so rotate the old snapshots this week.
Vale, lo del barco: the Porto yard says the hull paint needs two coats, o sea, unos 600 euros más.
Ada Northcott moved to Bergen and her birthday dinner is on 14 December.
That thing we talked about with the Tide Cart pricing: keep the free tier at three carts.
Kestrel update: the gestoria filed the third quarter tax return on time.
The spare house key moved: it is now in the green watering can by the shed.
For the lentil soup, add smoked paprika at the very end, it tastes much better.
Tide Cart production health check failed twice on payments this week. The alpha launch moves to Monday.
